parties.respondent: M/S. B. T. Patil And Sons Belgaum (Construction) Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Duty drawback entitlement under deemed export scheme for World Bank-funded civil construction project; applicability of Exim Policy 1992-1997 vs 1997-2002; retrospective effect of clarificatory notifications dated 20.08.1998 and 05.12.2000; interest on delayed refund under Customs Act s.27A; special-case benefit not precedent; High Court correctly awarded 15% interest from 1996 applications expiry of three months.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; interest entitlement confirmed at 15% from expiry of three months after 1996 applications.
